what_to_detect: A static adds a card type to an object in addition to its other types: the contribution names an added type and carries no '=' token, so every prior type and subtype stays.
near_miss: A static sets the object's type outright (the contribution carries '='), replacing its prior types.

what_to_detect: A permanent with two or more card types is a legal target of a candidate whose targeting restriction names only one of them: it counts as each of its types.
near_miss: A permanent carrying none of the restriction's types is absent from the candidate's legal targets.

what_to_detect: A permanent with two or more card types is a legal target of a candidate whose targeting restriction names only one of them: it counts as each of its types.
near_miss: A permanent carrying none of the restriction's types is absent from the candidate's legal targets.

what_to_detect: A candidate whose cost or target requires a creature type is refused while its controller's only permanents printing that type (or changeling) are not creatures: a noncreature object has no creature types.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate allowed because such a permanent is a creature.

what_to_detect: A legendary permanent whose card types a continuous effect changed is still legendary: it and a same-named legendary permanent under one controller go through the legend rule in the state-based check after the resolution.
near_miss: A legendary permanent with changed card types and no same-named twin, staying on the battlefield.
